figures.name: Pressures timeline
figures.label: Figure 1: Funding and organization timeline
figures.precedes: The pattern is the same across every failure
figures.caption: Platforms pulled back, government funding was cut, owners retrenched, and nonprofits failed. Each event is tagged with the cohorts it hit hardest.
figures.source: Sources: company announcements, congressional record, CPB, news reports, 2018–2026.

figures.name: Nine-cohort card grid
figures.label: Figure 2: The Nine Cohorts
figures.follows: Worker-Owned Co-ops, Emerging Civic Actors and B2B/Professional Services
figures.caption: The 169 organizations in the dataset, grouped by who holds control and how money moves. Each card shows the cohort's size, its dominant revenue model and named examples.
figures.source: Source: Nodes and Networks dataset, n=169.

figures.name: Defector revenue and revenue per subscriber
figures.label: Figure 3: Defector Media Timeline
figures.caption: Fast growth off an inherited audience, then a plateau. Revenue per subscriber rose steadily while total revenue flattened.
figures.source: Source: Defector Media annual reports, fiscal years 2020–21 through 2024–25. Revenue per subscriber not disclosed for 2024–25.

figures.name: Grant dependency lollipop
figures.label: Figure 4: Percent of funding from grants and donations in nonprofit news organizations
figures.follows: No organization in this dataset sits above $10 million in revenue
figures.precedes: Track the same organizations for three years
figures.caption: Of 17 nonprofits between $3.5 million and $10 million in revenue, 15 get more than 80% of it from grants and donations. Each dot shows the share from contributions.
figures.source: Source: most recent IRS Form 990 filings.

figures.name: Band position by cohort (stacked bar)
figures.label: Figure 5: Percent of cohorts in revenue bands
figures.follows: That’s a story about fragility in one part of the map
figures.caption: The share of each cohort below $3.5 million, between $3.5 million and $10 million, and above $10 million in annual revenue. Most cohorts lean hard toward one end; Barbell Hybrids and Philanthropic Networks are the exceptions.
figures.source: Source: Nodes and Networks dataset, n=169.
